name: AddContactToCampaign
label: Add Contact to Campaign
description: Adds a Contact to a Salesforce Campaign by creating a CampaignMember record.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to Connect With
fields.description: The Salesforce connection credential to use for authentication.

fields.name: ContactId
fields.label: Contact ID
fields.description: The Salesforce ID of the Contact to add to the campaign (required).

fields.name: CampaignId
fields.label: Campaign ID
fields.description: The Salesforce ID of the Campaign to add the Contact to (required).

fields.name: Status
fields.label: Status
fields.description: The status of the CampaignMember (e.g., 'Sent', 'Responded'). Default is 'Sent'.

fields.name: CampaignMemberId
fields.label: Created CampaignMember ID
fields.description: The Salesforce ID of the newly created CampaignMember record.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response returned by Salesforce after adding the contact to the campaign.
